description: Defines the HttpStreamRequest class and its delegate interface, which manage the creation and handling of HTTP and bidirectional streams within the Chromium networking code. Contains callback interfaces, request management, and stream configuration details.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest
classes.description: Represents a client's handle to the process of creating an HttpStream, managing its lifecycle, and handling callbacks for success or failure.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for callback methods to handle stream readiness, failures, proxy auth, certificate errors, and QUIC status.

classes.name: HttpStreamRequest::Helper
classes.description: Interface providing load state, request completion, proxy auth restart, and priority setting.

methods.name: HttpStreamRequest
methods.description: Constructor initializing a stream request with URL, helper, delegate, WebSocket helper, net log, and stream type.

methods.name: RestartTunnelWithProxyAuth
methods.description: Resumes stream creation after proxy auth credentials are collected.

methods.name: SetPriority
methods.description: Updates the priority of the request.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Marks the request as complete with negotiation details.

methods.name: AddConnectionAttempts
methods.description: Records connection attempts made during the request.

methods.name: GetLoadState
methods.description: Returns current load state of the request.

methods.name: alternate_protocol_usage
methods.description: Returns the reason for using a specific transport protocol.

methods.name: using_spdy
methods.description: Indicates if the stream is over SPDY.

methods.name: websocket_handshake_stream_create_helper
methods.description: Returns the WebSocket handshake stream create helper.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Returns the URL associated with the request.

methods.name: stream_type
methods.description: Returns the stream type (HTTP or bidirectional).

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Indicates if the request has been completed.
